[IDSP.6.2] Dispatcher entry: `ds_dispatcher_call(engine,
service, correlation, args, arg_count, cooldown_ns)` — arguments
arrive as typed values:

| Arg | DS type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| service     | String | "domain.method" string from the lowered `call <domain>.<method>` |
| correlation | String | the call's `as` value, or the per-activation value generated for a call with none ([LCRS.3.1]); never `null` or empty; flows verbatim to the answer's `corr` slot |
| args        | typed arguments | one per kwarg the call supplies, sorted by name ([RLOW.7.3.1], [NCBK.6.10]) |
